title: Magus of the Library
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Theo, a poor boy with pointed half-elf ears, lives with his sister in a desert village where he is barred from the library and treated with prejudice. A meeting with Sedona, a Kafna librarian from the great book city of Aftzaak, changes his life, and he sets out to become a Kafna himself. The fantasy explores books, knowledge, politics and belonging.
life_message: Knowledge should be open to all, and a person's worth does not depend on birth, poverty or appearance.
